title: The 3 Best Deep Fryers Under $50
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for deep fryers under $50, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at deep fryers under $50 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Presto Dual Daddy Electric Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual-well design with removable divider, 1500W element, Automatic thermostat.
strengths: Real deep fry performance at the lowest price point in the category
Removable divider lets you fry two different foods without mixing flavors
Automatic thermostat holds temperature without manual adjustment
Nonstick cast aluminum body cleans up fast, an underrated feature at this price
Highest customer rating of any fryer in this roundup
limitations: 1500W element is the slowest to recover of any fryer covered on this site
8-cup capacity limits batches to small portions per well
No digital timer or viewing window

products.name: Hamilton Beach 35021 Electric Deep Fryer, 8 Cups
strengths: Fry with the lid closed to reduce splatter
Removable oil tank, lid and heating element for cleaning
limitations: Oil must be drained by hand

products.name: T-fal EZ Clean Compact Deep Fryer, 1.8 L
strengths: Dishwasher-safe parts except the heating element
limitations: Lower wattage means slower heat recovery
Takes time to cool before filtering

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
